selection.groupTitle.defaultMessage: Group — move, lock and delete these as one

selection.label.description: Screen-reader name of the toolbar for several chosen areas.

selection.lock.description: Button: stop the chosen areas being moved.

selection.lockAll.description: Tooltip of the Lock button when several areas are chosen.

selection.ungroup.description: Button: undo a group, so its areas move on their own again.

selection.unlock.description: Button: let the chosen areas move again.

selection.unlockAll.description: Tooltip of the Unlock button when several areas are chosen.

sheetLightbox.counter.description: Counter under a printed sheet shown full screen, e.g. “Sheet 2 / 5”.

sheetLightbox.lookCloser.defaultMessage: Double-click, pinch or Ctrl + scroll to look closer
sheetLightbox.lookCloser.description: Tooltip on a printed sheet shown full screen.

sheetLightbox.nextSheet.description: Button in the full-screen sheet view.

sheetLightbox.previousSheet.description: Button in the full-screen sheet view.

stage.addArea.description: Hidden name of the button that adds an area.

stage.addAreaTitle.defaultMessage: Add an area to the page

stage.boxes.description: Checkbox: draw each area's dashed outline on screen.

stage.boxesOffTitle.defaultMessage: No boxes — press for each area's dashed bounds, its badges and the trim edge (screen only, never printed)

stage.boxesOnTitle.defaultMessage: Each area's dashed bounds, its badges and the trim edge, screen only — press to draw every tie as well

stage.boxesTiesTitle.defaultMessage: Boxes, and every tie between areas drawn as its thread — press to turn boxes off
stage.boxesTiesTitle.description: Tooltip of Boxes when showing ties too.

stage.card.description: Screen-reader name of the card pager.

stage.dots.description: Checkbox label when the grid is drawn as dots.

stage.draw.description: Hidden name of the button that opens drawing for the chosen area.

stage.drawTitle.description: Tooltip of the draw button beside the page.

stage.fullScreen.defaultMessage: Look at this card full screen

stage.gridTitle.defaultMessage: {major}mm grid with a {minor}mm subgrid; dragging snaps to it ({key}). Press again for {next, select, dots {a dot grid} none {no grid} other {ruled lines}}.
stage.gridTitle.description: Tooltip of the Grid checkbox; key is its keyboard shortcut; next is what pressing switches to.

stage.guides.description: Checkbox: show margins and alignment guides.

stage.guidesFullTitle.defaultMessage: Page margins, alignment guides and spacing: a drag shows its millimetres to its neighbours — press to hide the spacing
stage.guidesFullTitle.description: Tooltip of Guides when fully on.

stage.guidesOffTitle.defaultMessage: No guides — press for the page margins, alignment guides and spacing

stage.guidesPartTitle.defaultMessage: Page margins and alignment guides, without the spacing — press to turn guides off
stage.guidesPartTitle.description: Tooltip of Guides when on without spacing.

stage.label.description: Screen-reader name of the area showing the card.

stage.lockAgain.description: Screen-reader name of the padlock just after unlocking.

stage.locked.defaultMessage: The design is locked — press to unlock it
stage.locked.description: Tooltip of the padlock beside the page.

stage.move.defaultMessage: Move — areas drag where you press them. Press for zoom and pan: scroll and pinch without dragging; the cross brings out a nudge pad.
stage.move.description: Tooltip of the mode button when areas can be dragged.

stage.nudge.down.description: Tooltip of the nudge pad's down arrow.

stage.nudge.gapLarger.defaultMessage: Gap {step}mm larger — further from the area this one follows
stage.nudge.gapLarger.description: Tooltip of the nudge pad's down arrow for an area tied under another.

stage.nudge.gapSmaller.defaultMessage: Gap {step}mm smaller — closer to the area this one follows
stage.nudge.gapSmaller.description: Tooltip of the nudge pad's up arrow for an area tied under another.

stage.nudge.label.description: Screen-reader name of the on-screen nudge pad.

stage.nudge.left.description: Tooltip of the nudge pad's left arrow.

stage.nudge.right.description: Tooltip of the nudge pad's right arrow.

stage.nudge.step.defaultMessage: Step size — 1, 5 or 10mm. Drag it to move the pad; hold it to put the pad away.
stage.nudge.step.description: Tooltip of the nudge pad's centre.

stage.nudge.up.description: Tooltip of the nudge pad's up arrow.

stage.pan.defaultMessage: Zoom and pan — a finger scrolls, areas stay put; tap one and nudge it with the pad. Press to drag areas again.
stage.pan.description: Tooltip of the mode button in zoom and pan mode.

stage.panLabel.description: Hidden name of the mode button.

stage.readOnly.description: Screen-reader name of the eye button in a read-only tab.

stage.readOnlyTitle.defaultMessage: Read only — the card being edited in another tab. Press for Open Here, Read Only or Close.
stage.readOnlyTitle.description: Tooltip of the eye button in a read-only tab.

stage.redoTitle.defaultMessage: {action} — hold, or right-click, for every step, to go forward several at once
stage.redoTitle.description: Tooltip of Redo; action is “Redo” with its shortcut.

stage.selectMultiple.description: Hidden name of the select-multiple button on a phone.

stage.selectMultipleTitle.defaultMessage: Select multiple — then every tap adds an area or drops it

stage.selectingMultiple.defaultMessage: Selecting several — every press adds an area or drops it. Press to stop, or Esc.
stage.selectingMultiple.description: Tooltip of the select-multiple button while it is on.

stage.showPad.description: Button: bring back the on-screen nudge pad.

stage.stopSelecting.description: Hidden name of the select-multiple button while it is on.

stage.stray.defaultMessage: Bring stray areas back onto the page
stage.stray.description: Hidden name of the button that moves off-page areas back.

stage.strayLockedTitle.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# area is not wholly on the page — unlock the design to bring it back} other {# areas are not wholly on the page — unlock the design to bring them back}}
stage.strayLockedTitle.description: Tooltip of the stray-areas button on a locked design.

stage.strayTitle.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# area is not wholly on the page — bring it back on, and nothing else} other {# areas are not wholly on the page — bring them back on, and nothing else}}

stage.undoTitle.defaultMessage: {action} — hold, or right-click, for every step, to go back several at once
stage.undoTitle.description: Tooltip of Undo; action is “Undo” with its shortcut.

stage.unlocked.defaultMessage: Unlocked — press again to lock it
stage.unlocked.description: Tooltip of the padlock just after unlocking.

stage.zoomActual.description: Zoom option: the paper at its real size.

stage.zoomActualEstimate.defaultMessage: The paper at its real size, measured for a {panel} — the commonest screen of this resolution, so it may be off
stage.zoomActualEstimate.description: Tooltip of Actual when the screen is guessed; panel is a screen model.

stage.zoomActualKnown.defaultMessage: The paper at its real size, measured for a {panel}
stage.zoomActualKnown.description: Tooltip of Actual; panel is a screen model.

stage.zoomFit.description: Zoom option: fit the page in the window.

stage.zoomTitle.defaultMessage: Zoom — double-click to go between Fit and the zoom before it

stage.zoomUnknownScreen.defaultMessage: This screen is not one the app knows, so this is the browser’s own millimetre, which may not match a ruler
stage.zoomUnknownScreen.description: Tooltip of Actual on an unknown screen.
